name: Auguststraße — 80 m simplified street study
limitations: LoD2 roof forms are generalized; façades have no photographic textures or window/door geometry.
Ground between buildings is interpolated from building bases.
The comparison uses neutral extrusions of the existing OSM building data, without invented shopfronts.
The textured mesh source could not be retrieved because its portal and tile endpoints returned maintenance pages.
detailScope: 80 m of Auguststraße; a narrow surrounding block supplies context.

appearanceReferences.title: KW — current visitor page and facade photograph
School restoration — architects and detail photographs

appearanceLimitations: Simple flat-roofed forms use official ground outlines and wall heights; this view deliberately simplifies roof shapes.
Mapped floor counts are used where available; other counts are estimated from height.
KW and school colours and main window patterns are reference-informed; neighbouring facades and street props are illustrative.
No reference photographs are redistributed or used as facade textures.
groundConnection: Additional foundation skirts join source ground outlines to interpolated terrain. Surveyed vertices remain unchanged; skirts are a rendering adaptation.
